rules.statement: "conflict of claims" within the meaning of Section 523 of the Civil Procedure Code exists when there is a discrepancy in the interests of parties such that one party's claim takes precedence over another's.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) The pleadings in the case disclosed a "conflict of claims" between the widow and the executor within the meaning of Section 523 of the Civil Procedure Code, in view of which the claim of the executor has to be preferred to that of the widow.
